finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Through the concept of time,” Jake shrugged. “More specifically... well, I guess you didn’t tell the arrows when to start moving again with a mental command. That would likely have drained too much energy. So my guess is that you infused each with a packet of Willpower that effectively put each arrow on a timer, and you perfectly executed the shots so everything lined up.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “You delayed the three first arrows so they would launch at the same time as the fourth one,” Jake said.
